trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE p.birth_date = '1973/11/25' RETURN p.college AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE p.birth_date = '1973/11/25' OR p.birth_date = '1973-11-25' OR p.birth_date = '1973/11/25' RETURN p.college AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player) WHERE p.birth_date CONTAINS '1973' AND p.birth_date CONTAINS '11' AND p.birth_date CONTAINS '25' RETURN p.college AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE p.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND (p.birth_date CONTAINS '1973' OR p.birth_date CONTAINS '11/25' OR p.birth_date CONTAINS '25/11' OR p.birth_date CONTAINS 'November 25' OR p.birth_date CONTAINS '25 November') RETURN p.college AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, p.name AS name_player
